name: After § 58
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the white paper on the future of European defence
part_text: 58b. Condemns the environmental impact of military expenditure and operations, which significantly contribute to the climate crisis while remaining exempt from standard emissions reduction targets; calls on the Commission and the Member States to include defence industry emissions in the EU’s climate targets, mandate transparent and independent reporting of military greenhouse gas emissions, and progressively reduce the military sector’s carbon footprint; stresses the urgent need to redirect public resources away from militarisation and towards sustainable investments that address the real security threats posed by climate change;
